variety: Tier and state differences improved, yet repeated shield/lightning icons and similarly sized nodes still make branches hard to distinguish semantically.
conflict: Stronger branch differentiation must not introduce a separate style per branch, and making all connections explicit must not create visual clutter.
resolution: Use one restrained connector system and shared node grammar, varying only branch labels, icon families, and tier scale while removing the competing background wordmark.

Preserve the circular node grammar, but give each branch a semantically distinct icon family and subtle single accent tint while using scale only for root and capstone hierarchy.
